chapter: Mambo, the Palladium and Cubop City
title: How "Asia Minor" was arranged and completed
summary: The composer brought an arrangement lacking the right clave meter and bass syncopation; Rene, Mario, Machito and Bobby Rodriguez supplied the missing notes.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Okay, a few weeks later you recorded "Tanga" again for Verve, with Flip Phillips, and not long after that you recorded "Asia Minor". Now, how was "Asia Minor" - when was the first time someone presented "Asia Minor" to you, for a recording? Was it the composer Roger King Moizan?
Was he in your band at the time?

No, he played with another band, and he say to Mario: "Hey, Mario, I have a number, gee, I would like you to play. I am going to give you the lead sheet". No, as a matter of fact, he made the arrangement.

He made the arrangement and we play it, but naturally, he didn't have the meter, the correct meter that we used. Clavé, like we use, and the bass syncopation was missing, one or two notes that was the ones to complete the meter; so Rene, Mario and myself we wrote that. Bam, bam, bin bin, bam bam bin bin, pang, pang, ping, pang pa. They wrote pang pang ping ping pang pa, incomplete. It was nice, but for - to us is something was missing, so in those days, Roberto, Bobby Rodriguez, was playing with us. A good musician, and he had the knack because - without being nationalist or patriotism, or whatever you want to call it - all his family are Cubans. He was born in Key West, where they were listening to Cuban music twenty-four hours. In his house, Sexteto Habanero, Septeto Nacional, used to come when Septeto Habanero and Nacional come to Florida to play dances. They used to go

to the house. His uncle was a tremendous bass player with the Cuarteto Caney, so he had all that thing that you just can't avoid to have because you grew up with it. He had the education of that particular syncopation on the bass, so for him it was very easy to put whatever was lacked that particular part of the bass.
